title: TaskGroup
description: Schema for a planner-agent task group file. See .claude/PROTOCOL.md for full contract.

group.description: Stable snake_case identifier for this group (e.g. 'voter_management'). Immutable after creation.

summary.description: One sentence describing what the group achieves end-to-end.

depends_on_tasks.description: Stable group ids (not filenames) of groups that must be fully done before this group starts.

id.description: Unique task identifier in format GROUP-NNN (e.g. VOTER-001, VOTER-REV-1).

title.description: Short imperative sentence describing what must be done.

marker.description: Bare token dispatch key. See PROTOCOL.md §5 for agent routing.

depends_on.description: IDs of tasks (sibling or cross-group) that must be done before this task starts.

skills.description: Skill names the worker must activate (e.g. ['implement-service', 'implement-mapper']).

target_paths.description: Repository-relative paths of files this task creates or modifies.

produces.description: Fully-qualified Java types or file paths this task creates (enables dependency analysis and Postman controller detection).

consumes.description: Fully-qualified types or generated symbols this task depends on (avoids workers needing to grep the repo).

instruction.description: What to build — pure instruction, no acceptance criteria or constraints here.

constraints.description: Spec rules that limit how to build it (e.g. 'No @Transactional', '409 via real DB constraint').

acceptance_criteria.description: The sole contract for DEVELOP and TEST tasks. Non-empty on DEVELOP/TEST; empty array on CONFIG/REVIEW. Single-sourced — not duplicated in instruction.

api_format.description: MUST be set on [API] tasks only. MUST be null or absent on all other markers.

user_stories_covered.description: MUST be set on [REVIEW] tasks only. Lists user stories verified in this review.

spec_ref.description: Pointer to the architect spec sections relevant to this task.

doc.description: Repo-relative path to the architecture document (e.g. '.flow/2-architecture/01_voter_management.md').

sections.description: Stable section heading anchors within the doc (e.g. ['## Service Layer', '## Exception Strategy']).

state.description: Runtime execution state. Planner writes initial values; workers and Orchestrator mutate during execution.

status.description: Current task status. See PROTOCOL.md §2 for the full state machine.

review_verdict.description: Set by reviewer-agent on [REVIEW] tasks. Null until reviewed.

rework_tasks.description: Task IDs that need rework after a REQUEST_CHANGES verdict. Populated by reviewer-agent.
